class.name: GaussianSplatWorldGenerator
class.brief_description: Deterministic synthetic test-world generator for the beyond-VRAM benchmark.
class.description: Generates the seeded, re-iterable synthetic worlds of the beyond-VRAM benchmark (tiers [code]T0[/code], [code]A[/code], [code]A-mini[/code] and [code]T-smoke[/code], plus chunk subsets used as quality references) as plain [code].gsplatworld[/code] files, streamed chunk by chunk without holding the world in memory. Each world gets a sidecar [code]<stem>.manifest.json[/code] with the generator parameters and their SHA-256, the exact per-class content table, the features (towns, walls, foliage, coded beacons) and per-chunk counts, bounds and SHA-256 digests. The same parameters always produce the same bytes. Generated worlds are never written under [code]res://[/code].

method.name: apply_overrides
method.description: Returns [code]{"ok": true, "params": ...}[/code] with [param overrides] merged into [param params]. Every override key must already exist; otherwise [code]ok[/code] is [code]false[/code] and [code]message[/code] names the key.

method.name: generate
method.description: Generates the world described by [param params] at [param world_path] and writes its manifest next to it. A non-empty [param chunk_selection] (sorted chunk indices of the full world) writes only those chunks, byte-identical to the full world's. Returns a report with [code]ok[/code], [code]message[/code], the digests, counts and timings. On failure nothing is published at [param world_path].

method.name: get_manifest_path
method.description: Returns the sidecar manifest path of [param world_path].

method.name: get_params_sha
method.description: Returns the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of [param params] ([code]generator_params_sha[/code]), or an empty string if [param params] is not a complete parameter set.

method.name: get_tier_names
method.description: Returns the names of the built-in tier presets.

method.name: get_tier_params
method.description: Returns the parameter set of a built-in tier, or an empty [Dictionary] for an unknown tier.

method.name: plan
method.description: Computes the world's layout without generating it and returns its splat and chunk counts, the per-class content table and the expected file size.

method.name: verify
method.description: Re-reads [param world_path] and checks it against its manifest: file size and digest, header fields, chunk records and every chunk digest. Returns [code]{"ok": bool, "problems": Array}[/code].
